## Summary

- Explain the change and why it is needed.

## Testing

- [ ] `bun audit`
- [ ] `bun run generate:check`
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] `bun run test:e2e`

## Checklist

- [ ] Linked an issue, or explained why one is not needed
- [ ] Added or updated tests for behavior changes
- [ ] Updated docs for user-facing changes
- [ ] Committed generated registry outputs when `sources.toml` or generator behavior changed
- [ ] Called out breaking changes, migrations, or deployment notes
